assessments.reasoning: The publisher archive links the exact 15.0 HTML, whose title identifies the ECMAScript 2024 Language Specification. The PDF cover independently identifies the June 2024 edition. The freshly acquired exact publisher bytes match the frozen SHA-256 eabb3c1fc6c5b0610b143ef7bea8de7c0f323a777d669a453e47c39a2986c846. Each OptionalExpression production in §13.3.9.1 obtains baseValue and returns undefined on either nullish value before ChainEvaluation. This is a conditional shortcut after evaluating the base and retrieving its value. The frozen condition requires successful evaluation and retrieval for an actual OptionalExpression production in the exact edition. The clause uses abrupt-completion propagation for evaluation and GetValue. Its explicit two-value test does not include false, zero, or the empty string. The separately acquired Corrigendum 1 replaces the copyright notice without altering this clause.
